description: This file defines API routes related to exporting posts as HTML, Markdown, and PDF in a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers, utility functions for content conversion, and access control logic.

methods.name: ensure_owner(post: Post, user: User)
methods.description: Checks whether a user is the owner of a post or an admin; raises HTTP 403 if unauthorized.

methods.name: str to_markdown(title: str, content: str)

methods.name: str to_html(title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Wraps post content in a simple HTML template for HTML export.
